spans.s:
āmikṣā
------------------------------------------
When milk is drawn in the morning and heated, and then the sour milk of the previous evening is added to it, the mixture divides itself into two portions, the solid one being called आमिक्षा and the liquid one, vājina. आमिक्षा is also called payasyā. It is offered to the विश्वेदेवस् during the चातुर्मास्य sacrifices.
